title: Establish authenticated identity and ownership authorization
rootCause: Make authenticated identity and user-scoped authorization mandatory before protected database behavior is considered valid.

defectReproduction.baseline: Authentication returned null; the schema had no user_id; RLS used auth.uid() is not null; protected handlers only parsed input; and the validator did not require ownership semantics.
defectReproduction.proof: Regression tests reject unauthenticated handlers, broad RLS, missing ownership, and incomplete generated security contracts, while accepting the complete generated contract.

trustBoundary: Generated customer project server boundary: Supabase Auth identity -> Server Action/Route Handler authorization -> Postgres user_id ownership enforced by RLS.
correctionSummary: Generated Supabase Auth now verifies the server session and fails closed; protected handlers re-check identity and compare database ownership with user.id; rows bind user_id to auth.users; RLS explicitly covers authenticated SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE with ownership predicates and write WITH CHECK; deterministic validators enforce these contracts before reviewer execution.

securityContractBefore.authorization: Not mandatory in protected handlers; client input validation only.
securityContractBefore.ownership: No generated user_id binding or server-derived resource owner comparison.
securityContractBefore.rls: auth.uid() is not null allowed every authenticated user to read every row.
securityContractBefore.privilegedAccess: No service-role bypass in baseline templates.

securityContractAfter.authentication: Server-only Supabase SSR client calls auth.getUser(); missing/error identity returns null.
securityContractAfter.authorization: Each protected handler re-checks identity and denies when the database owner differs from user.id.
securityContractAfter.ownership: Generated user_id is a non-null auth.users foreign key.
securityContractAfter.rls: Authenticated owner-only policies cover SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE; INSERT and UPDATE include WITH CHECK.
securityContractAfter.privilegedAccess: No service-role credential is generated or used for ordinary requests.

policyChangeScope: Generated customer template only: approved_records_select, approved_records_insert, approved_records_update, approved_records_delete.
testsAdded: Generated backend ownership contract regression coverage in src/agents/implementation/backend.test.ts
